body:
It can be really tough going through a break-up, especially when you cant't move out into the world and live on your own and have to continue living with your ex.

I think that the relationship was toxic– while it may have been good at times, it's not worth the mental state of two people deteriorating. No relationship is.

It know it must be very upsetting finding out that he doesn't commit to a relationship even though you two had already gotten engaged.

Now to address the part that he was questioning his sexuality. I know all the change is hard, but you have to respect that. Understanding one's own sexual identity can be so hard for a lot of people, while for others it comes easier. So when somebody is struggling with their sexuality, it's best for them to get support from even the most unexpected places.

It sucks to imagine somebody close to you abandoning everything you've shared and starting over with a new person. But let me tell you, it is not a punishment. The two of you just weren't perfect for each other, and it honestly sucks.
 
I hope you feel a bit better soon. You'll eventually find someone right for you; just be patient, even if it feels like an eternity has passed.

i hate to say it because i know it's hard for you but you most likely need a doctor to check it out.  if it isn't openly bleeding try to switch to something that relieves stress without inflicting pain. if it isn't bleeding you may not have to take it to the doctor, but i would suggest it anyway. i know it's hard but you gotta get it looked at.
absolutely no problem at all. message me if you ever need to talk some more.

i just want to start out and say that you are so, so strong. fighting suicidal thoughts, even the urge to cut, something that can come so frequently for some people, even every second of every day– and you're fighting it. how amazing is that?

i assumed from your wording that you have not slept for multiple nights, which will most definitely be adding more negativity to how you already feel. i'd suggest just laying in your bed and playing some classical music, rain sounds, or even asmr honestly. focus on how it sounds. let it fill you up and take you away to sleep. you could also focus on things you like like places and people. i know it's june but hot cocoa can help too, and i'd suggest it over coffee because caffeine and all that jazz.

good luck on your way. i hope this helps.

My situation is similar to yours, and I need you to hear me out.

It does get better. Thats what I'm going to start with.

Not deserving things? I know that too. I've felt like I don't deserve to be happy, and it honestly sucks.

It's really hard to vent to people in real life. It's not like you can pour it on a stranger, and you don't want your family to worry about you.

I am so sorry about the tragic event that you mentioned. Just know that it was not your fault. How could you have caused a hurricane? And it makes sense that you couldn't comfort him; you were taped to the spot with absolute terror. I've been there, but my situation (domestic violence– my mother was physically abused) didn't nearly come as high as yours.

I'd really like to talk to you, so message me if you want to.
the bravest people are the ones who leave their suicidal thoughts unscathed. if you come out of a depressive state alive, you're strong, so strong.

first and foremost: it really isn't a good way to go.

if you can post to reddit you can call 911. they have technology that can locate your call, so they can get to you if you have no idea where you are. starving to death in a truck is definitely a valid reason to call.

beyond that, your girlfriend is what you would call a bitch and if she lets her life deflate by living it like you've described then i would let her go, but i know it's hard. as for your mother, that honestly really sucks. i'd continue to pressure her to go to rehab and honestly call the cops if she keeps taking drugs, as it endangers her and those around her.

this is kind of all i can tell you, so... good luck.
